---
title: "Statistics seminars"
subtitle: "DEMS seminar series in statistics, University of Milano-Bicocca"
toc: false
---

Researchers from other universities present their work at Milano-Bicocca. Seminars are in English, last about an hour and are open to the whole Bicocca community, students included. **The room changes from one seminar to the next**: check it here before you go. Seminars in economics and management are listed in the [DEMS events calendar](https://dems.unimib.it/en/events-category/seminars/dems-seminars).

::: {.seminars data-csv="data/seminars.csv"}
[Download the list of seminars (CSV)](data/seminars.csv)
:::
